subject: Renewal: staged VPC consolidation + phased on-prem expansion (SOW + term amendment)
summary: Customer asks to consolidate multiple on-prem footprints into a single managed VPC with phased isolation and a term amendment. We provided SOW, proposed 24/36 month term options, and outlined staged provisioning and SOC2 evidence. Procurement prefers 36 months and requested an amended contract + DocuSign.

Subject: Renewal & consolidation ask — MedElix private footprint

Hi Soojin,

As we head into our renewal window (June 30), the architecture and procurement teams asked me to check whether Redwood can help us consolidate three of our on-prem enclaves into a single managed VPC with staged isolation per region. The ask is:

- Create a new MedElix-managed VPC in us-west with three segregated namespaces (analytics, PHI ingest, model-serving)
- Provision an additional two GPU clusters for peak analytics (q3 start) and a standby cluster for failover
- Staggered cutover over 90 days so our ops team can validate DR and network ACLs
- We need a term amendment that covers the new capacity and an option for a 36-month rate to lock pricing

Can you confirm feasibility and an estimated timeline & topline pricing? Also ideally we need SOC2 evidence and a short SOW for our security and legal teams — they asked for something they can attach to the purchase order.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Infrastructure, MedElix
elena@medelix.com

[Attachment: medelix-current-footprint.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)]

Subject: Re: Renewal & consolidation ask — MedElix private footprint

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely support a staged consolidation into a single managed VPC and add the two GPU clusters + a standby cluster. High-level notes below and I attached an initial SOW and SOC2 snapshot for your security team.

Summary (high-level):
- Scope: new managed VPC in us-west, three isolated namespaces, 2x A100-class clusters for analytics (autoscale with predictable burst), 1x standby cluster (warm standby)
- Timeline: design & infra prep (2–3 weeks), cluster provisioning (2 weeks), staged cutover across namespaces (up to 90 days, customer-driven validation gates)
- Term options: 24-month (standard), 36-month (preferred by customer) with a 6–8% discount on committed capacity and a one-time onboarding credit applied at sign
- Deliverables: SOW, network topology diagram, SOC2 snapshot, runbook for cutover, change-control calendar

Attachments I've included: MedElix_SOW_v3.pdf, SOC2_snapshot_202704.zip, network-topology-annotated.png

Next steps I propose:
1) Preread: Priyom and Marcus to confirm technical feasibility and any constraints on warm standby sizing.
2) Commercial: Kimberly to draft a short-term amendment and price table for 24 vs 36-month options.
3) Signoff: Elena to share the PO timelines and any internal procurement gating items.

Happy to jump on a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the SOW.

— Soojin

Thanks Elena & Soojin — quick technical read:

- Feasibility: Solid. We can map the three current on-prem enclaves into separated namespaces (k8s-like tenancy) within a single VPC while preserving network ACLs and routing for PHI ingest.
- Standby sizing: Recommend standby with 50% warm capacity of analytics cluster (fast spin-up policy + pre-warmed KV cache) to meet RTO targets; this keeps cost sensible while meeting failover SLAs.
- Cutover plan: Design window (2 weeks) -> provisioning & validation (2 weeks) -> phased traffic migration (3 checkpoints across 90 days). We need MedElix to confirm a single change-owner for each checkpoint.
- Constraints: If MedElix requires air-gapped offline access for any namespace, that will push additional lead time and an on-prem appliance option (we can document this in the SOW).

I'll attach a short ops checklist to the SOW and can walk through the DR playbook on the call.

— Priyom
